note: Every question below is built from a catalogue record and its source URL. Questions that rely on unresolved or conflicting seed values were left out. Source review is still pending, so explanations cite the source recorded in the data.

questions.question: Which hardware landed in the Sea of Tranquility on 20 July 1969?
questions.explanation: The record states that Eagle landed in the Sea of Tranquility on 1969-07-20; its descent stage remains on the Moon.

questions.question: Which spacecraft is recorded as making the first true soft landing on the Moon?
questions.explanation: The Surveyor 1 record describes the mission as the first true soft landing on the Moon.

questions.question: How did the Lunar Orbiter 1 mission end on 29 October 1966?
options: It was commanded to impact the lunar surface
questions.explanation: The record says the spacecraft was commanded to impact the Moon. Published impact coordinates conflict, so no single location is given.

questions.question: For how many sols did Sojourner operate, far beyond its planned 7-sol lifetime?
questions.explanation: The Sojourner record states 83 sols of operation against a planned lifetime of 7 sols.

questions.question: In which year was the last confirmed communication with the Spirit rover?
questions.explanation: The last confirmed communication was on 2010-03-22. NASA ended efforts to contact Spirit in 2011, which is a separate date.

questions.question: Whose off-world driving-distance record of 45.16 km did Perseverance surpass in October 2026?
questions.explanation: The Perseverance record notes NASA reported 45.22 km driven by 2026-10-11, surpassing Opportunity's 45.16 km.

questions.question: How many flights did the Ingenuity Mars Helicopter complete?
questions.explanation: The record states Ingenuity completed 72 flights, far more than the original five-flight plan.

questions.question: Which Mars lander is recorded as confirming water ice in the Martian subsurface?
questions.explanation: The Phoenix record states it confirmed water ice in the subsurface and detected perchlorate.

questions.question: What did the InSight lander measure to improve understanding of the interior of Mars?
questions.explanation: The InSight record describes a geophysical mission that measured marsquakes.

questions.question: Why does a 'Successful' mission outcome not tell you whether hardware is still working?
options: Outcome and operational status are separate facts
Outcome is only about launch dates
questions.explanation: In this dataset, Viking 1 has a successful outcome, yet its communications stopped after a faulty command on 1982-11-11. Outcome, status and location are kept as separate fields.
